Thanks again for the demo last week — great discussion. Per our product team and the usage profile you shared, we can support a short pilot before committing to an annual program. Two quick things I want to confirm so we can draft the private offer:

- Target pilot length: are you able to do a 6-week or 6-month pilot? The economics and unit pricing differ materially; we can price both options.

Jasmine —

Thanks for the note. Quick answers from our end: we prefer a 6-month pilot with a clear go/no-go at month 4 based on ramp metrics. Procurement will sign, but our Cloud Procurement & Billing team requires partner sponsorship for any Marketplace private offers that exceed $50k over a 12-month equivalency — they treat private offers with longer terms as vendor-managed.

Action items for Redwood: can you provide a priced breakdown for (a) 6-week trial (b) 6-month pilot and (c) 12-month committed pricing with discount tiers; and confirm whether Redwood can accept the purchase order via a private offer with AWS partner sponsorship? Also please include draft payment terms (Net 30 vs Net 45) and any termination/cancellation language.

Simon
Head of Procurement
AcroSoft Analytics
